items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] At that time he was sounding like Roy Eldridge, wasn't he? [INTERVIEWEE] No.

ctx.x: That was in -- must've been in '39, early '39, because I -- he took my place, in a way, either he or Mario Bauza, they both came in the same time.
At that time he was sounding like Roy Eldridge, wasn't he?
